records.verificationNote: Tier 2, DL and QL 240 per 30 days for tramadol 50 mg read by x-coordinate on page 13. No PA or step on the immediate-release tablet. Judgment: tramadol 50 mg is the lowest-tier short-acting opioid. Combination products (hydrocodone, oxycodone and codeine with acetaminophen) are listed as alternatives because the class definition names them. Tapentadol (NUCYNTA) and codeine sulfate single-agent do not appear in the guide; the guide does not state it is complete, so they are not recorded as excluded. Methadone and the fentanyl and buprenorphine patches are outside this class. Controlled substance, so the limits are recorded in preferredRestriction. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: Re-confirmed against Humana formulary 26402, v17 (updated 10/01/2026), sources/humana-premier-rx-pdp-newtopics-2026-10.pdf (tier, PA, ST, QL read by x-coordinate; the v16 copy used in the first pass is superseded).
